question: What was the base of first generation computer systems?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vacuum tube based**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• First-generation computers, which were developed during the period from the late 1940s to the late 1950s, used vacuum tubes for circuitry and magnetic drums for memory.
 
• These computers were enormous in size, often taking up entire rooms, and consumed a large amount of electricity, generating a lot of heat.
